The self-test launches NOTHING (the .sh runs the two freeze harnesses; the selftest module holds no subprocess/exec/shell code, asserted by a defense-in-depth grep), makes no network call, and mutates no queue/tracked file. authority_flags (contract_frozen/process_launch_authority/write_gate_enabled/runtime_authority/default_authority) remain FALSE at worker scope; Codex review finalizes any authority. Adapter/runner/topic SELECTION must become a LEARNED router (MCP_NEURAL_LAUNCH_ROUTING_MIGRATION_V1); this deterministic self-test is only an ABCR/validator drift-protection tooth over the executor surface, never a runtime cognitive router.
